name: Service Call
description: Calls one of your services (a model or a program) with what comes in, and gives on its answer.
doc:
**Service** is a generic HTTP caller — point it at any local engine you run yourself.

**Pick a Service Preset** to fill the endpoint + method + body template + response path in one click (Ollama / LM Studio / ComfyUI / a speech-to-text server / generic). Manage your own presets in **Settings → Services** (web) or paste templates inline on the node.

**Templating** — the connected `input` is available as:
  - `{{input}}` — JSON-escaped + quoted (safe to drop into a JSON string slot)
  - `{{inputRaw}}` — raw substitution (use when input is already a JSON object/array)
  - `{{apiKey}}` — resolves the **API Key Constant**
  - `{{model}}` — the **Model** field
  - `{{system}}` — the **System Message** field (chat/LLM bodies)

**Response Path** uses dot/bracket notation: `choices.0.message.content`, `data[0].url`, etc. Leave blank to return the parsed body whole.

**Inline overrides win** — any field you fill on the node overrides the same field from the selected preset.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: The data to send — referenced as {{input}} (JSON-escaped) or {{inputRaw}} (raw) in the body template.

outputs.name: Response
outputs.description: The extracted response (via Response Path) or the parsed body when path is blank.

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Which service to call: one of OAIY's engine's models, a service of OAIY's, or one added in Settings → Services. The fields below change what it is sent.

properties.name: Model
properties.description: The model this step asks the service for. Empty: the service's own.

properties.name: System Message (LLM)
properties.description: What the model is told before the prompt: its role, its tone. For chat services; others ignore it.

properties.name: Body Template
properties.description: What is sent. {{input}} is this step's input, quoted; {{inputRaw}} is the input as it is. Not sent with GET.

properties.name: Response Path
properties.description: Where the answer is in what comes back (choices.0.message.content). Empty: all of it.

properties.name: Headers (JSON template)
properties.description: Headers, as JSON. {{apiKey}} is the key named below. Empty: Content-Type: application/json.

properties.name: API Key Constant
properties.description: The API key to use, by its name in Settings → API keys.
